mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in molecular structures to represent the "Rest of the molecule"."
The letter R is used in molecular structures to represent the "Rest of the molecule".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those objects (molecules) which are not superimposable on (cannot be made to coincide with) their mirror image."
Chiral objects (molecules) are those objects (molecules) which are not superimposable on (cannot be made to coincide with) their mirror image.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a position where an object can be cut in half and each half is identical."
Plane of symmetry is a position where an object can be cut in half and each half is identical.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the spontaneous dissociation of the alkyl halide to give a carbocation intermediate."
The rate- limiting step is the spontaneous dissociation of the alkyl halide to give a carbocation intermediate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the weakest of all the intermolecular attractions."
Van der Waals forces are the weakest of all the intermolecular attractions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a permanent state of polarization."
The inductive effect is a permanent state of polarization.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very widely used amide; it is involved in the treatment of drinking water and sewage, and in plastics manufacture."
Polyacrylamide is a very widely used amide; it is involved in the treatment of drinking water and sewage, and in plastics manufacture.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the parent compound of monosodium glutamate (known as MSG), which is used as a flavor enhancer."
Glutamic acid is the parent compound of monosodium glutamate (known as MSG), which is used as a flavor enhancer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used as a gasoline additive or alternative."
Methanol is used as a gasoline additive or alternative.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most reactive of the halogen radicals, and it reacts violently with alkanes (∆Ho = -31 kcal/mol)."
The fluorine radical is the most reactive of the halogen radicals, and it reacts violently with alkanes (∆Ho = -31 kcal/mol).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those substances which do not rotate the polarized light."
Optically inactive substances are those substances which do not rotate the polarized light.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are one of the most common and versatile reaction types in organic chemistry."
Nucleophilic substitution reactions are one of the most common and versatile reaction types in organic chemistry.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is described by valence-bond theory as a resonance hybrid of two equivalent structures and is described by molecular orbital theory as a planar, cyclic, conjugated molecule with six π electrons."

Benzene is described by valence-bond theory as a resonance hybrid of two equivalent structures and is described by molecular orbital theory as a planar, cyclic, conjugated molecule with six π electrons.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a complex mixture of alkanes and cycloalkanes that can be separated into fractions by distillation."
Petroleum is a complex mixture of alkanes and cycloalkanes that can be separated into fractions by distillation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the only forces of attraction possible between nonpolar molecules."
London forces are the only forces of attraction possible between nonpolar molecules.

chemical reaction

functional group

addition reaction

asymmetric carbon

Halogenation
Halogenation is the replacement of one or more hydrogen atoms in an organic compound by a halogen (fluorine, chlorine, bromine or iodine).
______ is a β blocker, a group of drugs used to treat hypertension.
Atenolol
Atenolol is a β blocker, a group of drugs used to treat hypertension.

special aldehyde
A special aldehyde is the molecule in which the carbonyl is bonded to two hydrogen atoms.
According to the course material, how many types of stereoisomers which are are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two types of stereoisomers which are: Conformational isomers 1) Configurational isomers Both types are stereoisomers that have the same molecular formula and the same connectivity and both of them have different arrangement in the space.
According to the course material, how many types of Configurational isomers which are are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two major types of Configurational isomers which are: 1) Geometrical isomers 2) Optical isomers Geometrical isomers (cis-trans isomers) are isomers that have the same molecular formula, the same bond connectivity but the atoms are in different non-equivalent positions to one another.
